title: A touchdown and a takeaway
summary: Travis Hunter caught a touchdown and intercepted a pass in the same game. Jacksonville’s team report identifies it as the first such NFL performance since 2002.

timeline.label: Fourth quarter
timeline.text: Hunter’s 7-yard touchdown catch cut Houston’s lead to 31–28.

timeline.label: Next Houston possession
timeline.text: He intercepted C.J. Stroud in the end zone.

timeline.label: Closing minutes
timeline.text: Jacksonville tied it at 31 before Houston won 34–31.

unusual: The same player supplied a scoring reception and a defensive interception, an uncommon two-way contribution in modern NFL personnel usage.
explanations: Offensive and defensive deployment created both opportunities. Rarity alone does not imply a hidden pattern.
questions: The historical comparison is attributed to team reporting, not an independently rebuilt all-time player database.

sources.label: Jaguars: two-way performance and historical comparison
